title: Owner expands a collapsed Tech View group and opens a work order using only the keyboard, and Tab returns to it after Back
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin, viewport 1280 px or wider; browser pinned to the fixture workplace
Saved Work Orders view reset over the API, then technician A pinned and A's group saved as collapsed
A throwaway customer with a unique name and no pinned note
One work order for that customer with one line and lead technician A

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Work Orders, pick Tech View and search for the unique customer
custom_steps_separated.expected: A's group header shows 1 work order and is collapsed, with no work order row under it

custom_steps_separated.content: Focus New work order and press Tab
custom_steps_separated.expected: Focus enters the table on the first row on screen

custom_steps_separated.content: Press ArrowDown until A's group header has focus
custom_steps_separated.expected: A's group header row is focused
Focus moves to the Expand A button
A's group expands (the button now reads Collapse A) and its work order row appears
The work order's row is focused
Tech View returns where it was, with A's group still expanded

custom_steps_separated.content: Focus New work order and press Tab
custom_steps_separated.expected: Focus lands on the same work order's row
